en: Black‑and‑white street scene showing an early‑20th‑century city intersection. On the left stands an ornate historicist corner building with a tall, steep roofed tower; on the right is a large, modernist/Art Deco style building labeled "Hotel Astoria". People in period clothing walk across the street, and a horse‑drawn carriage and an early motor bus are visible, suggesting a transitional era between horse and motor traffic. The printed caption at the top reads "Cluj" and "Hotel Astoria — Asztoria Szálloda".
